title: PR Review Invocation Test Matrix / Reviewer Statistics
description: One row per reviewer subagent invocation OR per end-to-end pr-review skill test cell. Records dispatch metadata (model_family/effort/dev_commit), runtime cost (tokens/tool_uses/duration_s), and verdict shape (findings_count + per-severity counts + verdict_prefix). Loaded line-by-line as JSONL/NDJSON: each line of the data file is one complete object matching this schema.

cell.description: Unique identifier for this row. For reviewer subagents, recommend `pr{NNNN}_{lens}_{model_family}` (e.g. `pr0916_runtime_sonnet`). For end-to-end skill tests, recommend `{H|S|O}-Run{N}` or `pr{NNNN}_{model_family}_{effort}`.

pr.description: PR number under review. NOT zero-padded.

model_family.description: Model FAMILY only - one of haiku / sonnet / opus. NOT the full model ID. Derive by extracting whichever enum token (`haiku` / `sonnet` / `opus`) appears in the system-prompt's model identifier, regardless of any `claude-` prefix or version/context suffixes around it (e.g. any `claude-<family>-X-Y` or `<family>-X-Y-...` form). Do NOT use a naive left-truncation like `.split('-')[0]`: the family token sits between prefix and suffix in `claude-opus-4-7`, so left-splitting yields `claude` (rejected by the enum). One-line reference: `next(t for t in ('haiku','sonnet','opus') if t in raw_id)`. Inherited from the main session unless explicitly overridden at dispatch. The enum is intentionally narrow so downstream rollups can pivot without normalization.

effort.description: Effort/thinking-budget setting at dispatch. Use lowercase forms (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`) or `default` when not explicitly set, or `MAX`/`HIGH`/`XHIGH (ultrathink)` for ad-hoc test cells.

dev_commit.description: Skill-version anchor at dispatch time. **New-format rows (`legacy` absent or false):** must start with a 40-char lowercase hex SHA from `git merge-base HEAD <base branch>` (the project's configured base branch), optionally followed by ` -- <freetext-suffix>` for human readability. Example: `cfadc5dc3f286e2b93a3cbce788764ee10a6f022 -- 1914-SKILL-pr_review_phase4 (self-referential dogfood)`. **Legacy rows (`legacy: true`):** freetext anchor for narrative-only states that have no recoverable SHA in git history (e.g. `dev (pre-#916)`, `main (pre-rename)`). The conditional schema (if/then/else below) enforces the SHA pattern only on non-legacy rows.

legacy.description: True for grandfathered rows whose dev_commit is narrative freetext with no anchorable SHA in git history. False or omitted = new-format row; dev_commit must match the 40-char hex SHA pattern. Use sparingly; new dispatches should always capture `git merge-base HEAD <base branch>` and set legacy: false (or omit it).

dispatch_shape.description: Whether this row was produced by a parallel-dispatched Phase 2 reviewer subagent (`parallel`) or by an orchestrator running inline with no fan-out (`inline`). Inline rows record the orchestrator's own usage envelope; parallel rows record one row per dispatched reviewer. Required so downstream analysis can pivot on dispatch shape without inferring it from the cell name.

tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by the subagent invocation (input + output, as reported by the harness).

tool_uses.description: Tool-call count from the subagent invocation envelope.

duration_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the subagent invocation, in seconds. Three decimals of precision (millisecond -> second conversion).

phase4_script.description: Whether the agent invoked `phase4_branch_safety.py` during its run. `yes` / `no` / `n/a (no script in dev)` / null. Null/omitted is correct for per-reviewer rows; reviewers don't run Phase 4 - that's the orchestrator's job. Meaningful only for end-to-end skill-invocation test cells.

findings_count.description: Total findings emitted by this reviewer. Should equal C_count + I_count + M_count + other_count for any row where all four severities were classifiable.

C_count.description: Count of Critical-severity findings. Use 0 for confidently-zero; use null for not-measured (during pandas load, fillna(0).astype(int)).

other_count.description: Count of findings outside the C/I/M scheme (e.g. Strengths, Notes, Observations). Typically 0.

verdict_prefix.description: First clause of the reviewer's verdict line. Conventional values: `READY TO MERGE`, `NOT READY TO MERGE`, `N/A (bailed)`. Free-form OK; downstream pivots key off the prefix string.

notes.description: Freeform residual narrative - unique catches, behavioral observations, philosophy tags. Keep short (one to three sentences). The structured columns are for pivots; this column is for the irreducible-prose part.

then.description: Legacy row: dev_commit may be narrative freetext.

else.description: New-format row: dev_commit must start with a 40-char lowercase hex SHA, optionally followed by ' -- <suffix>'.
